complete_examples.text: Railway tunnel Train-track-tunnel-soil coupled dynamics Soil dynamic stress Environmental vibration Cylindrical layer element Semi-analytical modeling A B S T R A C T A 3D train-track-tunnel-soil (TTTS) coupled dynamics model is developed in the time domain, where the spatial dynamic interactions between the subsystems can be characterized and captured.

In view of the environmental vibration caused by urban rail transit vehicles, there are some disadvantages in the parameter design and damping effect evaluation of steel spring floating plate track, such as high cost of field test, few working conditions, difficult test and difficult coordination of skylight time.
The research results show that the dynamic substructure method has significant advantages when studying the vehicle-induced environmental vibration characteristics of the building above subway lines.

By comparing the calculation results with that from the finite element model of the overall structure, the effectiveness of this method in the study of vehicle-induced environmental vibration was verified, and the problem of applying artificial boundaries was explored.
